summary: Control recurring service failures with complaint analysis, escalation matrices, and corrective-action reviews. Explore the course and outline.
lede: Complaint root-cause analysis and service-recovery governance helps service and complaints managers identify recurring failures and control how they are escalated. You’ll classify complaint patterns, trace causes with 5 Whys and process maps, and assign decision rights and escalation thresholds using RACI. You’ll also verify corrective actions and document recovery decisions so repeat cases and unresolved issues can be reviewed through operational reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for managers and specialists accountable for complaint controls, recurring service failures, and service-recovery decisions. It suits professionals who already work with service cases or operational quality.
prerequisites: Experience in customer operations, complaints, service quality, or service delivery is recommended. No coding or programming is required; familiarity with complaint records and operational processes will help you apply the exercises.
